prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: vertical Instagram cover image, 4:5
Primary request: A photorealistic Japanese kyotei motorboat racing scene on a wide lake course, with soft mountains on the horizon, an overcast sky, and gentle swell.
Scene/backdrop: wide Japanese lake, subdued distant mountains, overcast atmospheric sky.
Subject: one authentic kyotei single-seat racing boat, about 3 meters long, flat, low, and long relative to the racer; light white or pale-grey hull. OPEN cockpit only: no canopy, no roof, no windshield or bubble. A racer crouches or kneels very low inside, leaning forward with both hands on a small steering wheel; plain full-face helmet and plain racing suit; face fully hidden. One outboard motor mounted at the stern, creating a large white spray plume. The boat banks into a tight left turn around one orange-and-white cylindrical turn buoy, with spray curving outward.
Composition/framing: portrait 4:5; boat and buoy entirely in the lower half; reserve the top 45 percent as dark, uncluttered negative space for later title overlay; dynamic but realistic sports photography.
Lighting/mood: overcast, dramatic, restrained, natural photographic lighting.
Constraints: the boat must unmistakably be a Japanese kyotei racing boat, not an offshore powerboat and not an F1 tunnel boat; no recognizable real person; only one boat; no extra boats.
Avoid: absolutely no text, letters, digits, numbers, logos, brands, watermarks, signage, number plates, banners, emblems, symbols, or flags anywhere; no markings on helmet, suit, hull, buoy, motor, background, or water; no canopy; no roof; no windshield bubble.

verification.method: visual inspection of the generated image
verification.notes: Visually inspected at full image view. The image shows one low, long, light-colored, open-cockpit kyotei racing boat banking around an orange-and-white cylindrical buoy on a wide lake beneath an overcast sky, with soft mountains on the horizon. The racer is crouched low in a plain full-face helmet and plain suit with the face hidden. One stern outboard motor and a large white spray plume are visible. The boat remains in the lower half, while the upper 45% is dark and uncluttered. No text, letters, digits, numbers, logos, watermarks, signage, number plates, flags, or recognizable real person are visible.
